children: Hornbeck Offshore said its subsidiary received a multi-year decommissioning contract with what it described as a major operator in the North Sea.
The contract for Helix Well Ops has an initial term of two years with extension options, and begins in the second quarter of next year.
Hornbeck did not disclose the operator behind the contract.

"This new multi-year award builds directly on Hornbeck's previous success and strengthens our expertise in delivering safe, efficient, rigless decommissioning solutions in the North Sea," Chief Executive Todd Hornbeck said. "By leveraging our asset base and extensive operational expertise, we are proud to support our customer in executing our integrated decommissioning solution under a single contract."
